notes: Portfolio project ideas keyed by skill. Each idea is a suggestion to build real evidence, never something to claim.

projects.title: Public dataset KPI dashboard
projects.brief: Pick an open dataset (e.g. city transport or public health), define 3–5 KPIs, write the SQL, and publish a dashboard with a short written analysis.
projects.evidence: SQL queries in a repo, dashboard link, a one-page findings write-up.

projects.title: Simulated A/B test analysis
projects.brief: Simulate or use a public experiment dataset; compute effect sizes, confidence intervals and power, and explain the decision.
projects.evidence: Notebook with assumptions, results and limitations.

projects.title: End-to-end tabular model with honest evaluation
projects.brief: Train a baseline and an improved model on a public dataset with a held-out test set, cross-validation and error analysis.
projects.evidence: Repo with reproducible training script, evaluation report and model card.

projects.title: Model serving service
projects.brief: Wrap a trained model in a containerised API with input validation, health checks and basic latency monitoring.
projects.evidence: Dockerfile, API docs, load-test numbers you measured yourself.

projects.title: Infrastructure-as-code deployment pipeline
projects.brief: Provision a small cluster or managed service with Terraform and deploy an app through a CI pipeline with automated tests.
projects.evidence: IaC repo, pipeline config, a diagram and a teardown script.

projects.title: Scheduled ELT pipeline
projects.brief: Ingest a public API daily, load to a warehouse (e.g. PostgreSQL), transform with SQL/dbt, and add data-quality checks.
projects.evidence: DAG code, schema diagram, data-quality test results.

projects.title: Streaming events demo
projects.brief: Produce synthetic events to Kafka, aggregate them in near real time and store results.
projects.evidence: Repo with docker-compose, throughput you measured, design notes.

projects.title: Production-style REST API
projects.brief: Build a CRUD API with authentication, migrations, pagination, tests and OpenAPI docs.
projects.evidence: Repo with tests and CI badge, API docs.

projects.title: Rate-limited URL shortener
projects.brief: Design and build a URL shortener with caching and rate limiting; document trade-offs.
projects.evidence: Design doc, repo, benchmark you ran.

projects.title: Accessible component library
projects.brief: Build 5–8 accessible components with keyboard support and tests; audit with an accessibility checker.
projects.evidence: Storybook or demo site, audit results, tests.

projects.title: Deployed full-stack app
projects.brief: Ship a small app end to end: UI, API, database, auth, deployment and monitoring.

projects.title: Automated test suite for an open-source app
projects.brief: Write UI and API tests for an open-source web app, run them in CI, and report defects you find.
projects.evidence: Test repo, CI runs, defect reports.

projects.title: Load-test report
projects.brief: Load-test a service you built, identify a bottleneck, fix it and re-measure.

projects.title: Retrieval-augmented Q&A with evaluation
projects.brief: Build a retrieval pipeline over public documents and evaluate answer quality on a labelled question set.
projects.evidence: Repo, evaluation set, metric results and failure analysis.

projects.title: Fine-tuned image classifier
projects.brief: Fine-tune a pretrained model on a public dataset; report per-class metrics and failure examples.

projects.title: Published mobile utility app
projects.brief: Build and publish a small app with offline storage and an API integration.
projects.evidence: Store link or APK, repo, screenshots.

projects.title: Monitored cloud deployment
projects.brief: Deploy a service to a cloud provider with logging, metrics, alerts and a runbook.
